newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets aside 30 bln yuan to re-employ workers.
newsitem.headline: China sets aside 30 bln yuan to re-employ workers.

text.p: China's State Council, or cabinet, is to set aside 30 billion yuan ($3.6 billion) this year as a reserve fund for mergers and bankruptcies of state-owned enterprises, state media confirmed on Tuesday.
The funds will be used for re-employment programmes that will provide jobs for workers displaced by such mergers and bankruptcies, state media quoted economic tsar Zhu Rongji as saying.
"Providing conditions for a good settlement of these workers is an important way to help money-losing state enterprises out of their difficulties," Zhu was quoted as saying.
"And this can be done only by carrying out reemployment programnes," said Zhu, a vice premier and member of the standing committee of the Politburo.

The central government will increase the amount of such reserves on a year-to-year basis, while local governments should also support reemployment programs by raising money from different sources, he said.
About 10 million redundant workers are listed at debt-ridden enterprises, he said.
